craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of proclamation — the hammer now proclaims: breath demoted → rest unfolds → Māyā named → mother proclaimed → fence → double-held VERDICT. VERDICT: double holding kept double per BOUNDARY — within-difference AND that-nondual-made, no synthesis imposed; shinings shining keeps SA bhāsa-figure (L3 note). Rejected: (a) synthesizing the double → killed by BOUNDARY: the song must hold both. (b) smoothing that-nondual-made → killed: verdict formula verbatim. Read aloud: SO with-IN DIFF-er-ence, SHIN-ing's-SHIN-ing HOLDS-good — … THIS-world IS that-NON-du-al-MADE.

lines: So within difference, shining's shining holds good —
hence recognition's word: this world is that-nondual-made.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato bhede tu bhāsasya ghaṭate bhāsamānatā tenoktam pratyabhijñāyāṃ tadadvayamayaṃ jagat
notes: shining's shining keeps the SA's own bhāsa-figure (bhāsasya bhāsamānatā)

reads_against.argmap: What is the verdict? → Verdict: difference keeps shining-shining; recognition says the world that-nondual-made.
c1_essence: Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22).

Rest unfolds into freedom, doership, lordship; Māyā named from power alone; the beginningless mother-principle proclaimed; pervasion fenced to I-sharers; the world verdict that-nondual-made (vv23-27).
